name: פישוט ביטוי רציונלי – מכפלת שני שברים אלגבריים וצמצום (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Write the following expression in an equivalent form in which all common factors have been cancelled.

\[ {{CT:0}}\cdot {{CT:1}}\]

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
The first step is to write all expressions in factored form

\[ \frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:3}}\frac{{CT:4}}{{CT:5}}.\]

Next we look for common factors in the numerator and denominator and cancel these to give

\[ {{CT:6}}.\]

(Note, this question is very famous, and has appeared in the majority of algebra texts since Van Schooten introduced it in his textbook in Principia Matheseos Universalis (1651).  See Heller, H.F. (1940) Concerning the Evolution of the Topic of Factoring in Textbooks of Elementary Algebra Publish in England and the United States from 1631 to 1890. PhD, Columbia University.)
